hints.title: Two-Pass Reversal Invariant
hints.text: Reversing the entire character sequence places words in their reverse order, after which each individual word can be inverted back to normal orientation.

hints.title: In-Place Inward Swapping
hints.text: Use two pointers to invert the whole array, then scan through character positions to identify space separators and invert each segment between spaces.

hints.title: Full Inversion Followed by Token Inversion
hints.text: Reverse characters from index 0 to n - 1. Next, track word start at 0, iterate to each space or end of array, and reverse characters from start to end - 1, then reset start.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of characters in list s
complexity.notes: Optimal solution running in O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary space modifying array in-place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting words into auxiliary string lists requires O(N) extra space and fails the in-place constraint.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-pass pointer swapping modifies the existing character buffer without heap allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should perform the transformations entirely in-place with clean two-pointer boundary swapping.
